convert_openai_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert an OpenAI GPT TensorFlow checkpoint to a PyTorch model and save weights and config
run_convert_cli: run the CLI tool to convert OpenAI GPT checkpoint from TensorFlow to PyTorch format
load_tf_weights_in_openai_gpt: load TensorFlow weights into a PyTorch OpenAIGPTModel from a checkpoint folder
create_openai_gpt_config: create an OpenAIGPTConfig from a JSON file or use defaults for model architecture
save_pytorch_model: save a PyTorch OpenAIGPTModel state dict and configuration JSON to a dump folder
